Metadata.CommitMsg:
v0.6.0: 真多活（etcd Lease 心跳）——多副本 active-active + SetDesired CAS + GC 守卫

核心（ARCHITECTURE R15，兑现 v0.5.0 设计钦定下一里程碑）：
- 心跳落盘为 etcd 租约（/edgeflow/registry/heartbeats/<id>，grant-per-heartbeat，
  值 lastSeen）；判活 = etcd 视角 hb 键存在性（三态），NodeController 内存扫描
  在外部模式停用；断开事件(0s)/租约到期(TTL)双路径判活，本地覆盖规则防误删
- watch 缓存同步：ListByPrefixRev 锚定 + 事件流单调推进锚点 + ErrCompacted
  全量重载 + 应用器只读铁律 + 重扫对账兜底（判活正确性不依赖 watch）
- SetDesired 改 modRevision CAS（重试≤3，ErrDesiredConflict；L5 消灭整记录覆盖）
- GC 守卫删除（hb 键在→撤销；rev 不匹配→放弃零级联；网络错误→pending 重试带
  rev；L7 闭环）+ embed requeueGCEvent 一行修复
- 配置：NODE_LEASE_TTL（默认 300s，与 NODE_TIMEOUT 解耦）；MULTI_REPLICA
  → /healthz 绑定 etcd 连接（失联>TLL → 503 自愈），其余形态 v0.5.0 语义
- Chart：外部模式 replicaCount>1 放行（embed 脑裂守卫保留），自动注入
  MULTI_REPLICA/NODE_LEASE_TTL；Chart 0.6.0
- 测试：+17 用例（LeaseEtcdRegistry 契约 9 / CAS 5 / healthz+env 3），全量 33 包
  回归绿；进程级 E2E Phase A/B/C 全过（双副本心跳互见 0ms 差/判活一致/修复性
  重写/GC 闭环/活节点守卫/故障注入/healthz 三态）；12 二进制交叉编译通过
- 文档：ARCHITECTURE R15 / DEPLOYMENT §10.8 / RELEASE-NOTES-v060 /
  KNOWN-ISSUES §5⑥⑦闭环+§6(L12-L21) / API-COMPATIBILITY healthz 语义分叉

Vulnerabilities.Title: The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues
Vulnerabilities.Description:
The golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package is unsafe by design, has numerous known security issues, is not maintained, and should not be used.

If you are required to interoperate with OpenPGP systems and need a maintained package, consider github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/openpgp which is a maintained fork that aims to be a drop-in replacement for this package.
